products.title: Head Coello Motion 2026 - Head
products.description:
HEAD COELLO MOTION 2026 - Discover Head's most offensive racket with a lower weight. Created to impose your own rhythm on the court, with its forceful diamond format and high balance. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The HEAD COELLO MOTION 2026 is a different racket, with extreme power and a lower weight. Its materials are designed to squeeze it in the attacking zone, ideal for an offensive player. It is one of the new padel rackets in the Coello line.

PLAYER TYPE

It is perfect for players looking for a quick attack, superior maneuverability and controlled power, with the technological support of Head and the offensive spirit of one of the greats of current padel.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

In this new HEAD COELLO MOTION 2026, the weight is optimized to gain reaction speed and swing speed. This translates into smoother transitions, faster volleys and greater ease in accelerating the ball.

Its hybrid diamond shape maintains the offensive DNA, but with a more accessible and wider sweet spot than in past editions, also granted thanks to the renewal of the AUXETIC 2.0 system. 

The faces are manufactured with the CARBON HYBRID system, which combines carbon fiber and glass fiber. This set balances stiffness, control and strength to deliver consistent performance. Inside, we have a Power Foam core, which offers incredible explosiveness when hitting.

products.description:
ADIDAS ADIPOWER ATTACK 3 PICKLEBALL RACKET - It is designed for advanced players who seek maximum power in each shot.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The ADIDAS ADIPOWER ATTACK 3 PICKLEBALL RACKET is a model designed for an offensive game, where speed and punch make the difference.

PLAYER TYPE

It is aimed at advanced level players who base their game on attacking strokes.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

Its attack format places the sweet spot at the top of the racket. In addition, its thickness of 14mm. It offers a very interesting balance between power, feel and control.

- Spin Blade Max: is a rough surface that maximizes the effects of blows.

- Structural Reinformcement: is a carbon perimeter reinforcement that improves durability.

- Extra Power Grip: which consists of a longer handle (5") that increases inertia.

- Comfort Grip: padded EVA rubber handle and perforated surface for greater comfort and grip.

- Upgraded Edge Guard: it is a perimeter protector that protects the racket against friction.

products.title: Siux Fenix Elite 2026 - Siux
products.description:
SIUX FENIX ELITE 2026 - A powerful, diamond, high-end racket. This model, unlike the PRO version, is made of 3K carbon. 

INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Discover the new SIUX FENIX ELITE 2026, an effective racket in the attack zone. Its geometric diamond format offers high balance and leaves the sweet spot elevated, more towards the upper frame of the racket.

PLAYER TYPE

This padel racket favors attacking hits. Designed for advanced and professional level players who normally carry paddles of this type, in diamond format. If you are looking for power, it is one of the most powerful in the collection.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The SIUX FENIX ELITE 2026 and its charismatic geometric diamond shape. This format helps to print more power when hitting.

Its faces are made of 3K carbon fiber, which is the stiffest carbon we find on the market. It is accompanied by a high-density Eva rubber in the core. This rubber, together with the 3K type of carbon, provides hardness and a lot of power.

The surface has a matte finish with a sandy texture, ideal for improving contact with the ball and facilitating the generation of spin. This technical detail allows you to vary trajectories, adding greater control in topspin or slice shots.

products.title: Set Okami - Set Padel
products.description:
SET OKAMI - The SET OKAMI is a very complete padel racket for those who do not want to choose between attacking or controlling the point. The 3K carbon gives firmness to the shot and the Soft EVA rubber provides a more comfortable point and good ball response. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The name of the SET OKAMI padel racket comes from Japanese and refers to the "great spirit", with the wolf as the protagonist of a padel racket that SET wanted to make different both in terms of design and sensations. 

It is a racket that stands out for its high control and elegant design in gray and black.

PLAYER TYPE

This padel racket is ideal for medium-high, advanced and even competition level players who have a fairly complete game and change between defense and attack as required by the point.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The SET OKAMI has a new mold designed by Set Padel. It is a round format racket. It can also fit very well if you are looking for the feel of carbon but do not want an excessively hard racket, since the Soft EVA makes hitting more pleasant and easier to carry.

It is not a padel racket focused solely on hitting hard, but rather on having the resources to play a complete game.
